_comment: Tool: search_symbol_usage(symbols[], sha) -> [{file, line, symbol, snippet}]. Same tree-walk as search_imports.json, but regex-matches call sites for specific qualified function names (e.g. 'yaml.full_load'), skipping docstrings/comments -- an earlier version without that skip logic falsely matched a mention of 'yaml.full_load()' inside config.py's own module docstring; verified against the real demo repo before this was caught (see workflows/tools/_verify_search_symbols.js). Same setup as search_imports.json: needs a 'GitHub PAT' Header Auth credential, replace OWNER/REPO. Test standalone with {"symbols": ["yaml.full_load","yaml.unsafe_load"], "sha": "<head sha>"}.
name: AutoRelease Tool - search_symbol_usage
